_comment: PERSISTENT per-folder routing decisions, read by scripts/konspekt-remap-plan.mjs.
These are HUMAN decisions about individual books, not rules — which is exactly why they
live in data rather than in the planner's alias tables. A route wins over the hint map,
the subject aliases and the faculty overrides, and is still validated against
lib/faculties.ts like everything else (an unvalidatable route reports INVALID_TRIPLE).
Why so many foz reroutes: the .docx colour legend (p3193-p3200) maps BLACK to
'ерготерапевти и кинезитерапевти'. Whoever built konspekt-priority.json collapsed that to
faculty_hint='foz', and the planner then defaulted bare 'foz' to foz/obshtestveno — health
management, which the legend never implies. The two specialties the colour actually means

routes.subject: Физикална терапия
routes.why: konspekt_subject was 'Урология' (docx heading 'Физиотерапия и рехабилитация' was missed). Entry carries colour 000000 = кинезитерапевти. foz/kineziterapia already has Физикална терапия and Масаж.

routes.subject: Спортна медицина
routes.why: colour 171717 (near-black) = кинезитерапевти; foz/kineziterapia already has 'Спортна медицина' verbatim.

routes.subject: Патофизиология
routes.why: bare-foz entry; colour is 'auto' so the black inference is absence-of-evidence rather than evidence. Owner's decision: add Патофизиология to foz/kineziterapia, which already teaches 'Обща и специална патология'.

routes.subject: Фармакология и фармакотерапия
routes.why: Strongest colour evidence in the set: pure 000000, and the title itself says 'за ерготерапевти'. foz/рехабилитация is the ergotherapy specialty.

routes.subject: Клинична лаборатория
routes.why: Entry carries 7030A0 = мед. лаборанти alongside black; the foz hint is a derivation error. fzg/laborant already has 'Клинична лаборатория' verbatim.

routes.subject: Фармацевтична ботаника
routes.why: Entry carries FFC000 = Фармация alongside black; the foz hint is a derivation error. farmacia/farmacia already has 'Фармацевтична ботаника' verbatim.

routes.subject: Фармакология
routes.why: bare-foz entry, colour 'auto' only — no positive colour evidence either way. General pharmacology textbook; farmacia/farmacia already has 'Фармакология' verbatim.

routes.subject: Кинезитерапия при неврологични заболявания
routes.why: hint 'fzg' defaulted to fzg/sestra with subject 'Нервни болести', which fzg/sestra does not have. The book is kinesitherapy; foz/kineziterapia has this subject verbatim.

routes.subject: Образна диагностика - обща част
routes.why: hint 'fvm' is wrong — this is general diagnostic-imaging processing, and fvm has no radiology subject at all. fzg/rentgenov has this subject verbatim.

routes.subject: Биофизика
routes.why: NO_METADATA row. Forward match MEDIUM 0.806 margin 0.302; inverse lookup of its own title scores 1.000 margin 0.370 against 'Медицинска биофизика' [Биофизика]. Both directions agree with wide margins.

routes.subject: Анатомия и хистология
routes.why: NO_METADATA row. Forward 0.920 margin 0.375; inverse 0.920 margin 0.120 against 'Repetitorium anatomicum' [Анатомия на човека].

routes.subject: Анатомия и хистология
routes.why: NO_METADATA row. Forward 0.800 margin 0.194; inverse 0.800 margin 0.417 against 'Atlas of human histology' [Анатомия и хистология на човека].
